clips.send: A friend tired of expensive courses sends this to someone chasing wealth - relief that the book behind it all costs less than a coffee.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says there's one book he recommends above almost every other wealth book: The Richest Man in Babylon.

It's a fictional story, not a true one, but every principle in it is based on truisms followed by thousands of genuinely wealthy people throughout history. It's short, a fast read in one sitting, and you can still buy it for about $2.95.

Kevin Trudeau says if you actually apply the one simple principle in this book, it is nearly impossible not to dramatically increase your wealth over a few years.

Have you read it yet?

#kevintrudeau #money #wealthmindset #books #success #richestmaninbabylon

clips.send: A new manager sends this to a friend about to lead their first chaotic project - awe that calm authority, not panic, is what actually gets a team moving.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says one scene in the movie Patton is a masterclass in leadership.

General Patton's convoy is stuck in the mud, chaos everywhere, tempers flaring. He gets out, stops, looks around, assesses the situation, then calmly says, "We're going to get this done right now." Not I. We. Then he starts directing people and motivating them until the job gets done.

The speech at the start of that movie isn't fiction either. It's the real speech Patton gave his army before they went into Normandy, men who knew they could die the next day.

What would your team do if you led like that?

#kevintrudeau #leadership #success #mindset #business #history
